semantically_equivalent_models.justification: Both 'vanilla RNN' and 'standard RNN' refer to the basic form of Recurrent Neural Networks without any modifications or enhancements.

parent_models.justification: RNNS is a broad category that includes all types of recurrent neural networks, of which 'vanilla RNN' is a specific type.
RNN models is another general category that encompasses various forms of recurrent neural networks, including the vanilla RNNs.

closest_parent_model.justification: 'RNNS' is the closest parent model because it specifically refers to the category of recurrent neural networks, which 'vanilla RNN' falls under directly.

closest_child_model.justification: There are no more specific models listed under 'vanilla RNN' within the provided list that could be considered a Child Model.

sibling_models.justification: 'Variational RNN' is a sibling model because it is another form of RNN within the general category of RNNS, sharing the same closest parent but involving a variational approach.
Continuous-time RNN is another sibling as it falls under the RNNS category, similar to how Vanilla RNN does, but models continuous data.

closest_sibling_model.justification: 'Variational RNN' is the closest sibling because it also modifies the basic RNN structure slightly by integrating variational techniques, thus being a close variant.
